faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the questions most often asked before booking.
faq.stillText: Message us on WhatsApp or give us a call.
faq.address: Djerba tourist area, opposite Hotel Zenon
faq.whatsappMessage: Hello, I have a question before booking.

howToBook.q: How do I book a vehicle?
howToBook.a: Choose a vehicle on the Scooter rental page, enter your dates, the quantity and your contact details, then send your request. You can also message us directly on WhatsApp at +216 28 340 240.

confirmation.q: Is my booking confirmed straight away?
confirmation.a: No. Your request is first recorded, then the agency confirms it by WhatsApp or email. Please give a valid phone number and email address.

severalVehicles.a: Yes. You can choose several units of the same model in one request. For different models, send one request per vehicle or message us on WhatsApp.

changeOrCancel.q: How do I change or cancel my booking?
changeOrCancel.a: Contact us on WhatsApp with your name and rental dates.

howToPay.a: Payment is made on site, at the agency. There is no online payment.

deposit.q: Do I have to pay a deposit?

included.q: What is included in the rental?
included.a: The helmet, anti-theft lock and insurance are included, along with free pick-up at your hotel. For insurance details, please ask us.

whichVehicles.a: 50cc and 125cc scooters, an electric scooter, a three-wheel scooter, electric bikes and classic bikes. The available models are shown on the Scooter rental page.

condition.q: What condition are the vehicles in?
condition.a: Our vehicles are recent and in excellent condition.

availability.q: How can I tell if a vehicle is available on my dates?
availability.a: Enter your dates in the booking form: the agency checks availability and replies. If in doubt, message us on WhatsApp.

hotelPickup.q: How does the free hotel pick-up work?
hotelPickup.a: Enter your hotel's name in the booking form. The agency will explain the pick-up arrangements when it confirms your booking.

where.a: In Djerba's tourist area, opposite Hotel Zenon.

contact.a: By WhatsApp or by phone on +216 28 340 240.
